# chock-example

> A kill switch for your coding agent's wrong moves.

A GitHub template repository where Chock is already adopted: one policy per layer (hook, rule, skill).

## README

- [Application security for the code your agents write](README.md#application-security-for-the-code-your-agents-write): what gets refused, by area and tier
- [Install](README.md#install): the repository route and the plugin route
- [How it works](README.md#how-it-works): one policy per layer, and how to try each
- [What it stops](README.md#what-it-stops): what is installed here, and what to add next
- [Guardrails, not guarantees](README.md#guardrails-not-guarantees): tiers and limits
- [FAQ for people and agents](README.md#faq-for-people-and-agents): LLM use, data, agents, install, cost, SAST, OWASP
- [For tools and agents](README.md#for-tools-and-agents): machine-readable sources

## Docs

- [chock.sh/docs](https://chock.sh/docs): the Chock documentation
